key_idea: Count the spots on one side, then double them for both sides.
steps: On the side we see, the mushrooms have 3, 5, 4 and 2 spots.
The other side has 14 spots too. 14 + 14 = 28, so 28 frogs fit.

choice_feedback.A: If 2 got wet, 30 frogs would fit. Only 28 fit.
choice_feedback.B: If 6 got wet, only 26 frogs would fit. But 28 fit.
choice_feedback.C: If 8 got wet, only 24 frogs would fit. But 28 fit.
choice_feedback.E: If 3 got wet, 29 frogs would fit. Only 28 fit.
